summary: Senior software engineer with ~9 years building web applications and backend services across product teams in e-commerce and healthtech. Comfortable owning a service end to end — design, implementation, on-call, and the roadmap conversations in between.

Introduced a lightweight RFC process the wider platform org later adopted
